_meta.source: NHL API schedule + current rosters; MoneyPuck shots/skaters/goalies files for seasons 2025, 2026 (regular season), built by nhl_project/build_player_pool.py
_meta.note: Slate for 2026-10-09: every skater on the 8 playing teams' current rosters with NHL history, against tonight's real opponent. Stats combine last season and this season to date; recent-form fields are the last 5 games played. Opposing goalies are 'Projected' (most starts this season, then most recent ice time) unless DailyFaceoff confirmed them today. No injury feed: rostered players are assumed to play. ICF/iSCF are unblocked attempts; HDCF/iHDCF are those within 20 ft. Goalie GA60_proxy/xGA60_proxy are per 60 minutes of real ice time.
